title: add jsonschema strict-mode error reporting and openai-compat response_format handling
author: Priya Sharma
description: Motivation: make structured output via response_format=json_schema robust and transparent for users while preserving OpenAI compatibility. This PR implements strict-mode JSON Schema validation for API responses, improves structured error reporting with stable error codes and user-friendly messages, and updates the OpenAI-compat layer to understand the response_format parameter and its strict mode semantics. Design summary: add a jsonschema validator component with two validation modes (non-strict permissive validation that attempts best-effort coercions and strict validation that returns structured validation errors), surface a new structured error payload (error.code, error.message, error.path, error.hint) for programmatic handling, and wire the response_format param through the API gateway and compatibility layer so that clients using OpenAI-style response_format can opt into schema validation and strict mode. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged unless response_format is provided or strict mode is enabled via request flag or feature flag for rollout. Rollout plan: feature gated behind feature flag enable_jsonschema_strict; staged rollout to 10% then 100% after monitoring. Testing: unit tests for validator edge cases, integration tests for streaming+schema interactions, and SDK tests for Python/TS. Docs: reference doc added and examples updated. Related work: ENG-21234 implements validation harness, ENG-21890 tracked OpenAI-compat updates.

release_notes: Add response_format=json_schema with optional strict mode and structured validation error payloads. OpenAI-compat layer now accepts response_format and maps strict semantics. Backwards compatible: no change unless response_format or strict enabled.
